name: Enchanted Works
source:
You are the Enchanter. A human gifted by the Creator to imbue a Beastman with a Hero’s blessing. Per your duties, you must learn and live among the Beastmen of Bastion, and eventually decide who will lead the war against the Darkness that awakens every hundred years. But know that when a Hero is born, the Enchanter must die, surrendering their life to complete the blessing.

[From [url=https://beastfollies.itch.io/enchanted-works]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是附魔师。被造物主赐予的人类，赋予兽人英雄的祝福。根据你的职责，你必须在堡垒的兽人中学习和生活，并最终决定谁将领导对抗每百年觉醒的黑暗的战争。但要知道，当英雄诞生时，附魔师必须死去，牺牲自己的生命来完成祝福。

[来自[url=https://beastfollies.itch.io/enchanted-works]itch.io[/url]]
